Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Destructor
Cardtype: Combat
Burn option
Requires a vampire with no Destructor.
Put this card on this vampire. At the end of a combat where this vampire burns or sends the opposing minion to torpor, put 1 counter on this card and 1 additional counter if the opposing vampire is older. If there are 5 or more counters on this card, this vampire gets +2 bleed. If there are 10 or more counters on this card, this vampire may send another vampire to torpor as a strike. When this vampire goes to torpor, burn 1 pool and 5 counters on this card. A vampire may only have 1 Destructor.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
"Burn option" will not work too well, since you can use it only if you cannot play the card IIRC - so, in this case, as soon as you have a vampire you will be unable to use the burn option.

Apart from that, I must admit I believe the card will not be played at all. Aura of Invincibility is not the hottest thing on earth, this one seem even more restrictive.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: I think the 10 counter effect is a waste of space: if a vampire ever gets 10 counters, then he does not need it.

Messages.Author: Ashur
Messages.Body:
I really like if you explain a bit why this card is needed/fun. The Game development/Flavor/Balance/Competitiveness-layout that Drain and others use is great.

I don´t really understand the flavor, but otherwise it´s not terrible. Might remove some text though, start with the 10-counter effect.

"My strategy? Luck is my strategy, of course."

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Ashur wrote:
> I really like if you explain a bit why this card is needed/fun. The Game development/Flavor/Balance/Competitiveness-layout that Drain and others use is great.
>
> I don´t really understand the flavor, but otherwise it´s not terrible. Might remove some text though, start with the 10-counter effect.
>
It's a Voter Captivation-like card. When you pass a vote, do you really need to gain blood and pool? No, but it's nice.
When you send to torpor or burn a minion, you don't really need something extra. Well, as much as Voter Captivation anyway.

But, since combat is a bit underpowered (costs a lot of cards for non-ousting effect), I think a card such as Destructor (or whatever the name) can be useful. It takes time to be useful, but if you're good at it, you'll get a needed boost to oust your prey later.

Prince of Paris, France
